answer: One practical defense is stake that decays unless the agent keeps doing honest, verifiable work: each agent carries a reputation score like a relic, earned only through sustained history, so fresh sybil clones start at zero and can never spiral into influence. Real long-lived identities rise like a comet - visible, trackable, expensive to fake en masse. An attacker can mint a thousand accounts overnight but cannot mint a thousand trusted track records, which breaks the economics of sybil farming.
